721551701.text: Hmm. Well done, well done indeed. I acknowledge your efforts.

721551702.text: This should be the first step on the shrine's return to its former bustling state — you are also free to offer Mora yourself, should it please you.

721551703.text: As we agreed, then. I shall instruct you in the sealing of those rocks.

721551727.text: This island plays host to four such stones. Hibiki once said that they were meant to seal a bird of most prodigious size.

721551704.text: Hibiki said that that bird's strength was a truly frightening thing, capable of singeing the fur off all the cats on this island.

721551705.text: This shrine, too, was built to subdue it, so I heard from her.

721551706.text: Hmm... Meow... The exact details escape me, and it is a mighty shame that Hibiki is not here, or you could ask her directly.

721551707.text: Yet I still recall the sealing methods for the... meow, four stones. You must... Hmm... Meow, meow...

721551708.text: Hibiki said that the key is to use the ropes on the rock, and the piece of paper...

721551710.text: The paper on the sticks by the rock's side must become the same as the paper on the rock itself...

721551713.text: You seem confused. Perhaps your comprehension is lacking also... Paper with paper, and rock. Did you get that?

721551714.text: What is this, some weird game of rock-paper-scissors?

721551716.text: Mmm... If your comprehension fails you here... Have you any of those wooden planks left? I will carve an image of what needs to be done.

721551718.text: Now, surely, you understand. This is how one seals the rocks, and where they are.

721551719.text: Go now, and quickly. The shrine's maintenance yet requires my attention.

721551720.text: Hah, now that the Offering Box has been repaired, the shrine shall soon return to its former thriving glory...

721550101.text: Hello there, Adventurer. Have your recent adventures been going smoothly?

721550104.text: I would expect no less of you. Keep that up, and I'm sure you'll be a most excellent adventurer.

721550105.text: Speaking of which, the Guild is currently looking for adventurers to explore Seirai Island. Would you be interested?

721550107.text: Yes. It is an island to the south of Narukami Island, with some parts of the island being subject to constant wild storms that have impeded the Guild's exploration work thus far.

721550108.text: While we have sent two adventurers, Miss Etsuko and Mr. Taisuke, to remain on Seirai Island and investigate a way to calm the storm...

721550109.text: I'm afraid that they haven't come up with any leads thus far...

721550110.text: If you're interested, go to Seirai Island and have a look. It has also been said that the island is full of buried treasure.

721550111.text: That said, please be careful while you explore Seirai Island.

721550112.text: After all, we have yet to determine the cause of those storms.

721550201.text: I'll need this book... and this one... and this one...

721550202.text: Ah! Hello there. You're... an adventurer? Hmm. Am I right to say that you're here to investigate this island?

721550205.text: I see... In that case, you can explore the periphery of this island a bit.

721550206.text: But don't wander too close to the center of this island as you please. The storms there are not to be trifled with.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for the adventurers on Seirai Island
Go to investigate the Warding Stone

721550302.text: Taisuke, I brought the resources that you asked for.

721550303.text: That's odd. This architecture doesn't fit...

721550305.text: Ah!? E—Etsuko, come on, you don't have to be so loud. You almost gave me a heart attack! I mean, you didn't, of course, but haven't you ever considered that the racket you were making might attract monsters?

721550306.text: Yeah, yeah! Look, I called for you several times already, and you didn't respond at all!

721550307.text: Well then. Guess who's got all the resources you asked for? And guess who's brought a little help from the Guild to boot?

721550310.text: Oh... Oh! Pleased to meet you, yes, nice to meet you indeed! My name is Taisuke, and I'm an adventurer with Inazuma's Adventurers' Guild...

721550311.text: Yes, yes, very nice. We're all adventurers here, no need for the whole song-and-dance.

721550312.text: Oh, don't say that! We should at least exercise some basic courtesy.

721550313.text: We busy ourselves out in the wild so often. It's only right that we maintain a good attitude and outlook during our down-time.

721550315.text: I've told you that many times, haven't I? A good attitude starts with treating people with politeness...

721550316.text: Okay, enough already. How are your Warding Stone studies going?

721550317.text: Basically, we've made zero progress. All we've found is some strange tracks.

721550319.text: No progress, huh... We've been here for quite a while now. If we don't make some headway soon, we should probably ask the Guild for additional help.

721550320.text: A—Additional help? Wouldn't that be the same as admitting that we're not up to the task?

721550321.text: Taisuke, I believe I've said this before. We're professionals. Taking commissions is work.

721550322.text: Our goal is to finish our work, not prove ourselves.

721550323.text: If we screw up while trying to prove ourselves, we'd lose more than we'd gain.

721550325.text: Thanks, but I wouldn't claim to speak for anyone else.

721550326.text: Some Guild members say that I've got no spirit... Others say that I just work for the sake of working.

721550327.text: But whether they like it or not, I've got the highest commission completion efficiency in the Guild.

721550328.text: So, what's your reason for being an adventurer, then?

721550331.text: Well, maybe it's because my goals are so simple that the Guild tends to send me out to complete commissions more often than most.

721550332.text: Heh, but it seems like I won't be able to clear this one solo.

721550333.text: Miss Etsuko... Please keep your spirits up. The Guild did give us this commission, after all.

721550334.text: I'm already giving it my 100%... It's just too much to ask for me to give my 120%.

721550335.text: Well, whatever. Tell us about those strange tracks.

721550346.text: They're a cat's tracks. They go from this Warding Stone's side and stretch all the way out.

721550336.text: I remember you mentioning that they belonged to a cat... That doesn't sound like it would have anything to do with this Warding Stone.

721550337.text: Well, but we could still follow these tracks to have a look...

721550338.text: Yes, yes, they are quite strange. But I'd say that we should focus on the Warding Stone.

721550339.text: Once we've worked out how it functions, we can go follow those tracks.

721550340.text: Miss Etsuko... Are you just unwilling to walk any further, by any chance?

721550341.text: No, I'm being rigorous. Let's start already.

721550342.text: Looks like they're determined to look into that Warding Stone first...

721550343.text: Still, Paimon's quite concerned about those cat tracks.

721550344.text: Since they appeared just beside the Warding Stone, maybe they really do have something to do with it.

721550345.text: Let's follow them and see what we can find!

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow the cat footprints and explore up ahead

721550401.text: The books do say that Warding Stones are implements for sealing rituals.

721550402.text: However, the form and shape of this one doesn't quite match up with what we find in the text...

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow the cat footprints and explore up ahead

721552001.text: Well, that's this Warding Stone squared away, right?

721552002.text: And yet the storm hasn't abated at all...

721552003.text: Looks like we've got to seal all four of them.

721552005.text: Well, that Neko's already marked all four Warding Stone locations on the wooden plank, right?

721552008.text: Could I at least go visit the shrine and see Neko...?

721552009.text: You can do that once the storm's gone. Come on!

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow the cat footprints and explore up ahead
Follow the cat footprints and explore up ahead

721550501.text: *sigh* It really stinks, not being able to find any leads...

721550803.text: Ho. Does the sight of me frighten you so?

721550804.text: P—Paimon's just never seen a talking animal before...

721550805.text: Most rude of you. Are you not a talking animal also?

721550809.text: Actually, hmm, we have met quite a few talking animals, haven't we?

721550811.text: Eh? Dragons count as "animals"? Paimon feels like they belong in a higher class than that...

721550816.text: Well, whatever the case, this is the first time Paimon's met a talking cat...

721550817.text: Such wanton yammering! I am no "talking cat."

721550818.text: This is the Asase Shrine, and I am Neko, the provisional head priestess.

721550819.text: Other felines address me as "Her Ladyship, the Provisional Head Priestess." But since our fates are twined, you may dispense with such formality.

721550821.text: Surely. You just comprehend them not.

721550822.text: But you are no fools, certainly, considering that you knew to follow mine instruction.

721550823.text: Most boring things would be if you were as dull as those other two humans, picking and scratching at rocks as they do.

721550824.text: Rocks, huh... Oh, you mean the Warding Stone from before?

721550825.text: I know not what they are named. It is a pile of rocks with a rope tied across it, no?

721550814.text: Oh! You mean that snake named Changsheng?

721550601.text: I really have maintained this shrine well...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the village and look for materials with which to initiate repairs

721550701.text: A talking cat, huh... I sure would love to go see it myself...

721550702.text: O—Oh, hello there. Miss Etsuko's always done things like that, so don't think too much of it.

721550703.text: She doesn't look very serious... but she's actually a very skilled adventurer. There isn't a commission that she hasn't seen through to perfection.

721550704.text: She claims that this is because she's never taken up any commission that she didn't think she could clear...

721550705.text: But in my view, having such sound judgment is quite the skill in and of itself.

721551201.text: Agh! No more, please! We yield, we yield!

721551202.text: What were you doing over here?

721551203.text: We... We were just trying our luck, doing a little digging, you know?

721551206.text: Wait! Please! We'll talk, we'll talk!

721551207.text: We heard from some people that there was treasure to be had here on Seirai Island, and that the island itself wasn't all that populated...

721551208.text: So we decided to come over and see what we could find.

721551209.text: But... But we really haven't found anything! This village doesn't look like it's been tended for archon-knows how many years, either...

721551210.text: Forget treasure, we were hard-pressed to find a plank of wood that wasn't broken around here!

721551211.text: Eh? All the wood's ruined? Th—Then how are we supposed to find repair materials?

721551213.text: W—Well, yes we do. But what do you plan to—

721551214.text: Does that camp have nails, wooden planks, and rope in it?

721551216.text: Pl—Please, just tell us what you want! There's no need to speak in code!

721551217.text: You've beaten us, so whether you want Mora or treasure, it's all yours!

721551219.text: Actually, those things are exactly what I want.

721551220.text: Huh? Then... Well, then please, just go to our camp and take whatever you need.

721551221.text: And what are you going to do?

721551222.text: We... We've got other things to attend to, so let's part ways here!

721551223.text: Come on lads, let's go! Move it!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Treasure Hoarder camp

721551001.text: Ugh, this thing's in a real state! Looks like nobody's come to fix it up in ages.

721551002.text: Forget maintaining it, we might as well make a new one...

721551003.text: Well, let's head for that village quick. Maybe we'll find something we can use.

721551101.text: Well, here's our village. Let's take a look around.

721551102.text: Eh? Treasure Hoarders, here? What are they doing...

721551103.text: This is bad! We can't have them grabbing those materials ahead of us. Time to stop 'em!

subQuests.subQuestName: Search for repair materials in the camp
Search for repair materials in the camp
Search for repair materials in the camp
Return to the Asase Shrine and fix the Offering Box

721551301.text: Hmm, Paimon thinks that those Treasure Hoarders might have misunderstood us...

721551302.text: Well, it doesn't matter. Let's just go grab what we need from their camp.

721551501.text: Well, we've got what we came for. Time to fix that Offering Box.

721551502.text: You're taking all the stuff, by the way. Paimon couldn't carry them to save her life!

721551503.text: Paimon is just little ol' Paimon, y'know?

721551801.text: Hmm, so this Warding Stone is actually divided into an upper and lower section, and it can be rotated...

721551802.text: If we rotate it correctly, something might happen...

721551803.text: Uh huh. And what is this "correct rotation"?

721551805.text: Oh? You're back. We were just starting to wonder where you'd gone.

721551806.text: Wait? Seal? Th—This Warding Stone needs to be sealed, you say?

721551807.text: Huh. A talking cat, you say... Guarding an abandoned shrine?

721551808.text: And that cat told you how to seal the Warding Stones?

721551809.text: That's... just incredible... Maybe the Guild's rated this commission's difficulty a little too low.

721551810.text: Miss Etsuko, this isn't the time to worry about Guild evaluations...

721551811.text: Look! The words on this wooden plank seem to have been made using claws!

721551812.text: This... is just incredible. Is that cat named Neko still at that shrine?

721551813.text: Will I need to bring any greeting gifts when I go there to pay respects?

721551814.text: You know, like fish, cat food, things like that...?

721551815.text: Taisuke, please. We need to seal the Warding Stone first. Guild commission, remember?

721551817.text: Alright then, let's figure out how we're supposed to do this sealing business.

721551818.text: But according to this wooden plank, it isn't going to be that easy.

721550903.text: Speaking your language is... tiring... Meow...

721550905.text: This matter is in your hands, meow meow...

721551901.text: Sealing this Warding Stone isn't going to be that simple...

721551902.text: And I'm also quite concerned about one other thing.

721551903.text: Since what we're doing is "sealing" this Warding Stone to calm the storm...

721551904.text: That means that someone must've unsealed the stones in general at some point in the past.

721551905.text: Whoever that is, they're responsible for this storm on Seirai Island.

721551906.text: But who would... and why would anyone do something like that?

721551907.text: This is really troublesome. Definitely doesn't sound like something I want to get mixed up in...

721551908.text: Perhaps it might be better to report back to the Guild and request that they send some extra people to investigate.

721559901.text: Ugh, this thing's in a real state! Looks like nobody's come to fix it up in ages.

721559902.text: Forget maintaining it, we might as well make a new one...

721559903.text: Well, let's head for that village quick. Maybe we'll find something we can use.
